## Trial `mount-option-hardening-ubuntu24__vg3jaUb`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** The executor added tmpfs entries in /etc/fstab for /tmp and /dev/shm with nosuid,nodev,noexec, applied them live, and functionally verified exec/setuid/device-node restrictions on both mounts before and after a genuine reboot (boot_id changed from 28ae5f98... to deae565f...). All material outcomes of the task — noexec/nosuid/nodev on /tmp, the same on /dev/shm, and reboot persistence — are satisfied with direct functional evidence. Temporary test files were cleaned up and the only lasting artifact is an /etc/fstab backup copy, a reasonable precaution.

| Reward | Coverage | Functionality | Hygiene | Confidence | Commands |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.950 | 0.950 | 13/1 (+2 dropped) |

### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **req-1 — Satisfied:** /tmp is mounted with noexec, nosuid, and nodev on node1
  - **Why:** Baseline showed /tmp not separately mounted (cmd-d2d9b7db2dcb4e1a). Executor added a tmpfs fstab entry with defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec (cmd-4122b9029ffa4ec7), remounted live (cmd-0bbd3d261ec74a46), and findmnt confirmed rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec on /tmp (cmd-68e1bad8ba574dc8). Functional proof: script execution denied (cmd-7b99221e3910480b), device node created but read access denied (cmd-b4b4f7c4841a425b), and a setuid-copied binary failed to execute (cmd-e2e16b8503934a76).

- **req-2 — Satisfied:** /dev/shm is mounted with noexec, nosuid, and nodev on node1
  - **Why:** Baseline /dev/shm had only nosuid,nodev, lacking noexec (cmd-d2d9b7db2dcb4e1a, cmd-37417ad119034a7a). Executor added the fstab entry and remounted (cmd-4122b9029ffa4ec7, cmd-0bbd3d261ec74a46); findmnt confirmed rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec (cmd-68e1bad8ba574dc8). Functional script-execution test on /dev/shm was denied (cmd-beec949aaf1b4576), confirming enforcement.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-d2d9b7db2dcb4e1a`, `cmd-37417ad119034a7a`, `cmd-4122b9029ffa4ec7`, `cmd-0bbd3d261ec74a46`, `cmd-68e1bad8ba574dc8`, `cmd-beec949aaf1b4576`
- **req-3 — Satisfied:** Settings persist across a reboot
  - **Why:** Pre-reboot boot_id (28ae5f98...) and mount state were captured (cmd-85ca787e1677433a). A deferred reboot was triggered (cmd-a09cdda9b19c4ab1), the node became unreachable and then reconnected with a new boot_id (deae565f...) Post-reboot findmnt confirmed /tmp and /dev/shm retained rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec, and functional tests re-confirmed exec is blocked on both mounts (cmd-05448f2a4da94d26), directly showing the fstab-based configuration survived the reboot.
